gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-radio-canad: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz hits with big-bodied lowercase. Capture Smallz is best as a blunt display line, while Radio Canada Big does its best with monoline strokes and open-ended terminals.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-roboto: Capture Smallz sets a raw, tactical tone with its big-bodied lowercase. And Roboto reads smoothly beneath it, round letters with generous mouths and capitals barely taller than the body.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-ruda: Big-bodied lowercase gives Capture Smallz its raw, tactical stance. Capture Smallz is best at loud, low-contrast display lines, while Ruda is best at wire-like monoline text with wide-mouthed rounds.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-savate: Capture Smallz brings raw, tactical energy through its big-bodied lowercase. But Savate reads softly underneath, with sturdy hairlines, open curves and a tall round o nearly matching the capital.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-sintony: Chunky and raw, Capture Smallz stamps its big-bodied lowercase across the top with a distinctly tactical attitude. Sintony's chunky, smooth-curved text gives that loud heading somewhere quiet to land.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans stands its lowercase tall, like cut acrylic stencil pieces, with no thick-and-thin modulation anywhere. And Capture Smallz gives the raw, tactical top line, so the sans-serif text below moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-sofia-sans-: Big-bodied, raw and tactical: that is the look of Capture Smallz. It is best loud and low-contrast, while Sofia Sans Semi Condensed is best with a constant, pen-like line.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-sono: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz fills out its big-bodied lowercase with attitude. And Capture Smallz earns its keep big and short, while sans-serif Sono lets each a hang slightly open.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-tiktok-sans: Big-bodied and raw, Capture Smallz makes its tactical noise first. TikTok Sans then takes over as the sans-serif text, lowercase rising near cap height, with a spacious opening on the c.
gen-dafont-carrington-outfit: A tightly stitched, calligraphic hand gives Carrington its romantic, understated look. Outfit, a sans whose curves stop short of closing, grounds the script, and the duo is best for a line or two.
